description: Create a discount code customers type at checkout on the merchant's Shopify store, for every product: percentOff (20 = 20% off) OR amountOff (a fixed amount in the store's currency), with an optional minimum purchase (minSubtotal OR minQuantity, not both), startsAt (default now), endsAt, usageLimit (total uses) and oncePerCustomer. THE CODE WORKS AT THE LIVE CHECKOUT AND EVERY USE IS MONEY OFF THE STORE'S SALES, so without confirm:true NOTHING is created and the reply describes exactly the code that would be: show the user, get a yes, then call again with confirm:true. The reply after creating is Shopify's own copy of the code, read back. Nothing the user wrote is changed: an impossible value (a code with a space, 0% or over 100%, an end date in the past) is refused with the reason. The first time, the store may need to approve Hermoso's discount permission: the reply says how. Works for the Shopify store connected to this brand (Connectors ▸ Shopify, or connect_shopify_store) or the store this account was installed on. Free.

amountOff.description: a fixed amount off, in the store's currency (10 = 10.00 off). Pass this OR percentOff.

appliesOnEachItem.description: amountOff only: true takes the amount off EACH item; false (default) splits it across the order

code.description: what customers type at checkout, e.g. SUMMER20 (no spaces)

confirm.description: true to create it; without it nothing is created and the reply describes the code

endsAt.description: ISO date or date-time it stops working; leave out for no end date

minQuantity.description: minimum number of items in the cart. Pass this OR minSubtotal, not both.

minSubtotal.description: minimum order subtotal in the store's currency. Pass this OR minQuantity, not both.

oncePerCustomer.description: true = each customer can use it once

percentOff.description: percent off, more than 0 and at most 100 (20 = 20% off). Pass this OR amountOff.

startsAt.description: ISO date or date-time the code starts working; default now

title.description: the name shown in Shopify admin; defaults to the code

usageLimit.description: how many times the code can be used in total; leave out for no limit

name: create_shopify_discount_code
title: Create a Shopify discount code
